description: This file contains unit tests for the LDAPDao class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing LDAP-related data access methods, employee retrieval, user authentication, sync status management, and configuration setup within the LDAP plugin.

classes.name: LDAPDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying the functionality of LDAP DAO operations such as user retrieval, employee data fetch, sync status management, and configuration setup, within the OrangeHRM LDAP plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by populating the database with test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetEmpNumbersHaveManyUsers
methods.description: Tests retrieval of employee numbers associated with multiple users.

methods.name: testGetNonLocalUserByUserName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of non-local users by username, including cases for non-existing, deleted, disabled, local, LDAP, and non-LDAP users.

methods.name: testGetUserByUsername
methods.description: Tests user retrieval by username with various scenarios: non-existing, deleted, disabled, local, LDAP, and multiple auth providers.

methods.name: testGetEmployee
methods.description: Tests fetching employee data based on various filter parameters, including employee ID, number, SIN, license, email, SSN, and handling of non-unique results.

methods.name: testGetAuthProviderByUserUniqueId
methods.description: Tests retrieving LDAP authentication provider details by user unique ID.

methods.name: testGetAllLDAPAuthProviders
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all LDAP authentication providers configured in the system.

methods.name: testSaveLdapSyncStatus
methods.description: Tests saving LDAP synchronization status and verifying stored data.

methods.name: testGetLastLdapSyncStatus
methods.description: Tests fetching the most recent LDAP sync status record.
